name: Point at a target
description: Point the closed fingers at a target (finger axis within 8 deg) to indicate it.

precheck.name: hand_empty
precheck.meaning: The given gripper holds nothing (any: at least one does not; both: neither does).
precheck.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

verifier.name: pointing_at
verifier.meaning: Either hand's finger axis points at the target within 8 deg.
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.name: hand_empty
verifier.meaning: The given gripper holds nothing (any: at least one does not; both: neither does).
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_plan.selection: first path whose noun conditions all hold, decided before any motion
policy_plan.on_no_match: NO_PATH: the Contract refuses without moving

paths.note: The point skill on the motion layers (HAND_PLAN 9h); the old chain of primitives (close, aim, right_tcp_move) is gone.

relations.when: a gaze is enough to indicate the target

failure.automatic_fallback: nested calls only: a failed precondition with a matching repair fallback runs the repair once and retries; top-level calls stop
